product.name: AI Testing
product.description: An AI-powered platform for automating web application testing by simulating user interactions and maintaining tests automatically.

product.name: Test Editor
product.description: A no-code editor that allows users to create and edit tests using plain English, click recording, or custom code.

product.name: Parallel Execution
product.description: A feature that allows running thousands of tests simultaneously to scale testing efforts efficiently.

product.name: Localhost Testing
product.description: Support for testing web applications running on local development environments or behind firewalls.

product.name: AI Auto-Maintenance (Self-Healing Tests)
product.description: AI-driven automatic adaptation and maintenance of tests to handle UI changes and reduce manual upkeep.
